blockers: Two observed FPGA BDFs already have running FireSim processes; no deployment allowed.

Independent FireSim 1.17.1 is installed under firesim/upstream at b473147af03edc854a5bc2a95d1bc404c8711b2a, with its own Chipyard gitlink 336f225143590f9060ebe7101e96f235f96db985. Modified EC 1.9.0 sources still require a reviewed port to this 1.10.0 target tree.

Native Alveo platform source is now present in the independent install. Driver/bitstream build, exact board identity and per-card deployment isolation remain unvalidated; no original Chipyard-bundled FireSim is used for runtime.

rocket-chip/src/main/scala/packge.scala provides the legacy Config/Parameters alias, so different import names alone are NOT an incompatibility proof. Full FireSim API/platform compilation remains unverified.
True protection-free B RTL with matched BOOM/cache is not supplied. WithGHE removal does not remove independently instantiated BOOM/cache mechanisms.
Historical D uses WithNLargeBooms and default L2 while C uses WithNParaMedicBooms and explicit 1 MiB L2. Current outputs cannot be directly compared.
8 Rocket cores require hart 8; R_IC target/control paths and legacy interfaces contain 3-bit encodings. Count-only edits are not sufficient.
Current checker software is bare-metal with hardcoded hart cases; a Linux image that reserves and services checker harts for repeated PARSEC processes is unverified.
PARSEC has been copied from /home/wtl/parsec_gc. Existing RISC-V binaries link foreign checker objects and inspected blackscholes lacks __parsec_roi symbols; rebuild/admission required.
Passive statistics core and ROI ABI are supplied, but BOOM per-instruction execution timestamp taps, final-compare taps and exact CDC time conversion have not been integrated/validated in FireSim.
FASED timing at the candidate 200 MHz target bus clock must be generated and checked instead of using the default 1 GHz FireSim timing configuration.
No supplied mapped ASIC library, RAM macro policy, top RTL filelists or reviewed multi-clock SDC; DC executable presence does not establish license availability.
